name: Ice kick combo: stacked crescent arcs per kick, a rainbow-edged light streak and a one-frame spike burst, with empty rest beats between hits

source.title: Hazaze – Frigid Rush | Roblox Animation and VFX Showcase

phases.name: anticipation
phases.what: video 0:01.4-0:04.8. Spin kick wind-up: 3-4 thin concentric vertical crescent arcs wrap the kicker (white leading edge, cyan body, grey tail), a faint grey dust swirl on the floor

phases.name: release
phases.what: 1.73-1.95: the arcs close into a near-full vertical circle, then jump to 2x size in one frame (1.80), detach and drift up-back while fading to grey ghosts

phases.name: impact
phases.what: hit 1 at 2.23: small cyan-white puff + a long thin diagonal light streak (~5 m) with a rainbow fringe; new arc set on the next spin (2.37-2.6); rest beat 3.8; hit 2 at 3.87: one-frame spiky white-cyan starburst, then long white needle lines radiating at a low angle and a flat cyan ground ring (4.0-4.13)

phases.name: aftermath
phases.what: 4.13-4.8: needles thin out, the ring turns into a cyan spiral with grey dust, clean ~0.9 s after the last hit

layers.motion: 3-4 crescent ribbons at radii 1.0/1.3/1.6 m on slightly different tilts around the kicker, rotate with the leg over 0.3 s, scale x2 in one frame at the end of the swing, then drift 1 m up-back and fade over 0.15 s
layers.notes: a stack of arcs, not one: reads as a sphere of motion; grey at the tail so the fade is a colour change

layers.motion: low ground swirl of 6-8 soft puffs orbiting the feet, life 0.5 s
layers.notes: grounds the spin

layers.motion: one thin streak 5 m long shot along the kick direction, full length in 2 frames, fades over 0.2 s; RGB-split edge (pink on one side, cyan on the other)
layers.notes: a light streak instead of a burst for normal hits; the rainbow edge is the only extra colour

layers.motion: hit 2: spiky starburst 2 m with thin needle rays for exactly 1 frame, then a 0.4 m core for 1 frame
layers.notes: StarBurst with 10-14 spikes, hard alpha

layers.motion: 8-12 long needle streaks radiating within 20 degrees of the ground plane, 4-6 m, velocity-stretched, life 0.2 s, drag 4
layers.notes: needles keep the hit flat and wide instead of a round puff

layers.motion: flat ground ring 0.5 -> 3 m in 0.25 s, spinning, then breaks into a spiral swirl
grey dust ring spreading along the floor, life 0.7 s
layers.notes: the exit is grey dust, no lingering colour

layers.motion: tiny shake on hit 1, short medium shake on hit 2

whyItLooksGood: Each kick gets a stack of 3-4 arcs at different radii and tilts, which reads as a 3D sweep from any camera instead of a flat ribbon
The arcs double in size in a single frame at the end of the swing: the scale jump is the impact of the swing itself
Hits alternate shapes (a long rainbow-edged streak, then a one-frame spike burst), so a combo never repeats the same sprite
0.15-0.3 s rest beats with no VFX separate the hits so each one reads on its own
buildNotes: Video 0:01.4-0:04.8. Per kick: 3-4 CrescentArc instances (soft dialect, white edge, cyan body) parented to the attacker with yaw following the leg, radii 1.0-1.6 m and tilt offsets of 10-20 degrees; tween scale 1 -> 2 in one frame at the end of the swing, then translate 1 m up-back and fade to grey over 0.15 s. Hit 1: a thin beam-ribbon quad (5 m) along the kick direction with a chromatic shader (offset R and B copies 2-3 px apart) fading over 0.2 s. Hit 2: StarBurst (hard spikes) for 1 frame, Emitter of 10 velocity-stretched needles in a flat fan (drag 4), createRing on the floor with spin, then a SmokeBall dust ring in grey. Leave 0.15-0.3 s of nothing between hits.

phases.name: impact

phases.name: aftermath
phases.what: 7.2-8.2: pillar gone, decal fades from the rim inward to a soft blue ring, a thin horizontal ring hangs at chest height, sparkles twinkle out

layers.motion: 4-point star glint, long horizontal and vertical points (~1.5 m), on the falling attacker 0.13 s before landing; pops in 1 frame, shrinks over 0.1 s
layers.notes: the telegraph rides on the attacker, so the eye follows the fall

layers.motion: 1-frame white starburst with radial spikes covering ~50 % of the frame, centred on the impact
layers.notes: comes one frame AFTER contact (dead frame first)

layers.motion: on the next frame: 30-40 flat radial streaks sliding along the floor out to 5 m, life 0.25 s, drag 5
layers.notes: the flash is visibly flattened onto the ground: sphere -> ground spray in one frame

layers.motion: crisp thin floor ring 0.5 -> 4 m in 0.2 s
thin pillar 0.4 m wide, 8 m tall, 0.25 s, width shrinks to a line before fading
six-fold snowflake/frost-crystal decal 6 m with a rune tick band near the rim, full size in 1 frame, holds 0.4 s, fades from the rim inward over 0.6 s

layers.motion: translucent blue ice block (box) encasing the target, scale 0 -> 1 in 2 frames, holds 0.4 s

layers.motion: twinkling sparkles in a 4 m column, size pulse, life 1.2 s
one medium shake on the blowout frame

whyItLooksGood: The glint rides on the falling attacker, so the telegraph and the body arrive together
One empty frame between contact and blowout makes the blowout land harder
The blowout is a sphere for one frame and a flat floor spray on the next: the energy visibly hits the ground
The snowflake decal keeps the ice identity after the white flash is gone, and crystals float up instead of falling
buildNotes: Video 0:05.6-0:08.2. Attacker hang 0.5 s; spawn a 4-point StarBurst glint parented to the attacker 0.13 s before landing. On landing frame do nothing; next frame: ScreenFx white burst (or a large camera-facing StarBurst at the impact) for 1 frame, then replace it with an Emitter of flat radial streaks (velocity in the ground plane) + createRing. Same frame: LightPillar thin, ground-decal sprite with a six-fold snowflake texture (NEW texture) and a rune band, fade rim-first via a radial alpha threshold. Freeze the target: a translucent box mesh with fresnel. Instanced crystal shards with upward velocity 2 m/s and spin. Sparkle Emitter to finish.

phases.name: release
phases.what: 0.83-0.97: dark frame with black and cyan speed lines, then straight parallel neon cyan bars on navy

phases.name: impact
phases.what: 0.97 diagonal black/white split card, 1.03 X-ray: flat cyan skeleton silhouette on pure black, 1.10 inverted split card, 1.17 back to 3D with a white skull drawn over the head and horizontal smear streaks, 1.23 contact shot with thin black speed lines

phases.name: aftermath
phases.what: 1.3-2.4: thin curved splash strokes fan out and hang almost frozen for ~1 s while the camera holds (hit-stop)

layers.motion: 2-3 huge translucent sheets sweeping across the camera, 30 % opacity, 0.2 s
layers.notes: colour arrives before the fist

layers.motion: ball on the target's face 0.2 -> 0.6 m over 0.2 s, then bursts into radial slivers
layers.notes: the energy hits before the body does

layers.motion: 3 opaque flat brush strokes streak in from the side at eye level in 2 frames
layers.notes: toon strokes, hard edges, no glow

layers.motion: 2 frames of black/cyan diagonal speed lines, then 2 frames of straight neon bars (white core, cyan glow) on navy
layers.notes: the world disappears into graphics before the hit

layers.motion: 3 cards, 2 frames each: diagonal half-black/half-white split; flat cyan skeleton silhouette of the target on black; the split card inverted
layers.notes: the X-ray card says 'through the bone' in one image

layers.motion: 1 frame back in 3D: horizontal smear streaks across the frame and a white skull overlay on the head
layers.notes: a transition frame that blends card and world

layers.motion: 8-12 thin curved splash strokes fanning back from the contact point, 0.15 s to full length, then nearly frozen for 1 s, slow fade
layers.notes: the frozen splash IS the hit-stop; use the element colour if gore is not wanted

layers.motion: none during the cards, one heavy jolt on the first 3D frame, then a held still camera

whyItLooksGood: The X-ray skeleton card in the middle of the impact sequence explains the force of the hit instantly
The energy ball lands on the face before the fist, so the hit is anticipated by its own colour
Speed bars and neon strips remove the world for 0.15 s, making the return to 3D feel like a cut
The splash hangs in the air while the camera holds: a visible hit-stop instead of a time-scale trick
buildNotes: Video 0:00.4-0:02.5. Use ScreenFx for the release and impact: (1) diagonal speed-line card (black + cyan), (2) neon bar card, (3) split card, (4) skeleton card: a NEW silhouette card that renders the target's mesh with a flat cyan skeleton texture (or a pre-made skeleton sprite) on black, (5) inverted split. 2 frames each. Before that, a GlowSphere on the target's head and 3 opaque cyan brush quads. After: return to the world with one frame of horizontal smear (distortion), then 8-12 thin ribbon strokes from the contact point with time-scale 0.05 for 1 s (they barely move), heavy shake on the first real frame.

name: Invisible slash told on a black screen: a white-rimmed black band rotates and thins to a hairline, white frame, inverted X-ray card, then the wound line appears

phases.name: anticipation
phases.what: video 0:08.6-0:11.3. 8.6-9.83 slow close-ups of the hands and body with no VFX at all (held tension)

phases.name: release
phases.what: 9.87-10.2: cut to a dark navy screen; a thick black band with glowing white edges rotates from vertical to almost horizontal and thins to a hairline over 0.25 s, then a full white frame (10.2)

phases.name: impact
phases.what: 10.27 white card with a black outline skeleton of the target and a black diagonal band, 10.33 black card with a white diagonal wedge, 10.4 back in 3D: a thin white line still across the frame, 10.47 the target shows a diagonal red line across the torso

phases.name: aftermath
phases.what: 10.5-11.3: red specks drift slowly, the line holds

layers.motion: camera-facing band quad 30 % of screen width, black fill with a 2-3 px white glow rim, rotates 90 -> 10 degrees and thins to 1 px over 0.25 s on a dark navy background
layers.notes: the blade's swept plane seen edge-on: the cut 'closes'

layers.motion: 1 white frame; 2 frames white card with a black-outline skeleton and a black band; 2 frames black card with a white diagonal wedge
layers.notes: inverted X-ray: outline on white instead of fill on black

layers.motion: back in 3D, a hairline white slash line across the whole frame, fades over 0.2 s
layers.notes: the same line as the card, now in the world

layers.motion: a thin diagonal line on the target's body (a decal on the dummy), appears in 1 frame
layers.notes: result state; swap colour per element

layers.motion: 15-20 small flecks drifting slowly sideways, gravity 0.5, life 0.8 s

whyItLooksGood: 1.2 s of quiet close-ups with no VFX makes the sudden graphic sequence feel violent
Showing only the cut path (a rotating, thinning band) is clearer than showing a blade: you see the motion, not the object
The X-ray card is inverted compared with the punch move, so the same video has two distinct impact signatures
The 3D result is tiny (a line on the body), which makes the cards feel like the real event
buildNotes: Video 0:08.6-0:11.3. Hold the camera on the caster 1.2 s (no effects). ScreenFx: full-screen dark navy (#0a0f1c) with a camera-facing quad (black fill, white rim shader), tween rotation 90->10 deg and width 30%->0.2% over 0.25 s with ease-in. Then 1 white frame, 2 frames inverted skeleton card (NEW silhouette card, outline mode), 2 frames black card with a white wedge polygon. Back in world: a thin white line quad across the target at the same angle, a decal line on the dummy, a slow fleck Emitter. Medium shake only on the return to 3D.

name: Spiral ice sweep: many small comma streaks burst in one rotation direction, then two big ground crescents

source.title: Pew – Ice Moveset Showcase | Roblox Studio VFX

phases.name: anticipation
phases.what: video 0:56.9-0:58.0. Caster still among dark rubble, one blue glint at the hand (57.2), two empty crouch frames

phases.name: release
phases.what: 57.4-57.5: ~20 thin white comma-shaped streaks burst out around the waist, all bent the same way (spiral), blue slivers and a small white flash

phases.name: impact
phases.what: 57.6-57.8: two big flat crescent arcs sweep around on the floor (radius 5 -> 7 m), thick white leading edge, thin cyan tail, ends breaking into fragments

phases.name: aftermath
phases.what: 58.0: clean; a tighter double-spiral variant plays at 60.4-61.2

layers.motion: tiny blue glint at the hand for 1 frame
layers.notes: the only cue

layers.motion: 20 comma-shaped curved streaks spawned on a ring of radius 1 m at waist height, tangential + outward velocity 8 m/s, all curving clockwise, drag 3, life 0.3 s
layers.notes: many small shapes with one shared spin direction read as a vortex

layers.motion: 30 small blue ice slivers sprayed outward, life 0.25 s
2 flat crescents on the floor, 180 degrees apart, sweeping 120 degrees around while radius grows 5 -> 7 m over 0.3 s; tips erode into dashes
layers.notes: many small -> two big: the second beat is a scale jump

layers.motion: point light spike 0.1 s

whyItLooksGood: Every streak bends the same way, so a burst of particles reads as one spinning motion
The move goes from many small marks to two big ground crescents in 0.2 s: a clear scale jump
Total length is only 0.6 s of visible effect, which keeps a utility move snappy
buildNotes: Video 0:56.9-0:58.0. Emitter with a curved comma sprite (or short CrescentArc segments) spawned on a 1 m ring, velocity = tangent*6 + radial*4, add a constant angular term so all curve the same way; drag 3. Then 2 CrescentArc on the floor plane (toon dialect: white leading edge, cyan tail) sweeping 120 degrees with radius growth and tip erosion. Keep the caster's surroundings dark so the white reads.

name: Frost strike from the sky: light-shaft cue, warm spiky flash, ice column collapses into a snow dome, dark rubble bursts out of the dome and outlives it

source.title: Pew – Ice Moveset Showcase | Roblox Studio VFX

phases.name: release

phases.name: aftermath
phases.what: 63.75-64.2: only dark cubes arcing away and falling; the bright layer is gone first

layers.motion: 2-3 soft pale light shafts from the sky onto the spot, 30 % opacity, 0.4 s
layers.notes: telegraph from above, very soft

layers.motion: spiky starburst 4 m, 2 frames, spikes stretched upward on the 2nd frame
layers.notes: warm white for the flash, cold for everything after

layers.motion: short white column with a blue swirl at the base, 2 frames
hemisphere of 15-20 opaque toon snow puffs (r 4 m), pop in 1 frame, expand 10 %, break up after 0.35 s
layers.notes: a solid snow volume, normal-blended, so it occludes

buildNotes: Video 1:02.4-1:04.2. Telegraph: 2-3 thin LightPillar quads with low opacity tilted from the sky. Flash: StarBurst in cream for 2 frames. Dome: a cluster of SmokeBall puffs (normal blend, white with blue shading) placed on a hemisphere, plus one createRing arc on the dome top. At +0.2 s spawn instanced dark cubes on the dome surface with outward velocity and gravity; dome puffs erode away 0.15 s later. Debris lasts 0.6 s longer than the dome.

name: Ice cathedral: an inverted cone of thin light lines widens, narrows (implode), then a mound of cream-white crystal spikes erupts with frost puffs at the rim

source.title: Pew – Ice Moveset Showcase | Roblox Studio VFX

phases.name: anticipation

phases.name: aftermath
phases.what: 76.6-78: the cluster shimmers, shrinks slightly and fades while the camera orbits; dark rubble passes in the foreground

layers.motion: 20 thin vertical line quads on an inverted cone (bottom at the caster, top radius 3 m at 4 m height) + a white ring at the top; radius grows 10 % over 0.4 s, then shrinks to 50 % in 0.1 s
layers.notes: a lampshade of rays: readable from any angle and cheap

layers.motion: 30-40 crystal spikes (thin prisms) growing from the centre at random outward tilts, scale 0 -> 1 in 3 frames with overshoot, hold 1 s, shrink 20 % and fade over 1.5 s
layers.notes: hard solid shapes, cream-white with a cyan fresnel edge

layers.motion: frost puffs only at the rim of the mound, rolling outward, life 1.2 s

layers.motion: small shards spraying up and out for 0.6 s
1-frame flash at the cone tip as it turns into spikes
medium shake on the eruption

whyItLooksGood: The line cone is a clear 'it will come out here' marker that also tells the size of the area
It widens, then narrows for 0.1 s before the eruption: a tiny implode that times the hit
Solid spikes in the middle, soft puffs only at the rim: the ice reads as hard
The mound holds for over a second, giving a strong readable result shape
buildNotes: Video 1:14.5-1:18.0. NEW part idea: line-cone telegraph (N thin additive quads on a cone surface + a ring at the top), animate top radius. Then instanced crystal prisms (ConeGeometry with 4-6 sides) with random outward tilt, overshoot scale tween, normal-blended with a cyan fresnel. SmokeBall puffs spawned on a 3 m ring only. Sparks Emitter. Fade the mound by shrinking and alpha-eroding rather than a uniform fade.

name: Crimson ultimate opener: the character drains to grey, giant petals wipe the screen into a black void with a white crescent moon, red laser slashes and flower-star hits

source.title: Divergent Vfx – Acheron Ultimate | Roblox VFX

phases.name: anticipation
phases.what: video 0:00.5-0:06.7. 0.5-1.3 the caster's colours drain to grey (only red accents stay), 2.0 a long red blade is drawn with a thin red trail, 2.4 red petals orbit and a grey spiral vortex forms on the floor

phases.name: release
phases.what: 2.55-3.1: a red spiral ring and petals rushing at the camera; giant glossy red petals fill the whole frame (wipe); 3.3 the petals clear onto a black starry void with a wet reflective floor

phases.name: impact
phases.what: 3.5 a big white crescent-moon arc stands behind the target; 3.8 thin red laser streak from the blade to the target; 4.4 a red six-petal flower-star hit; 5.1-5.3 more horizontal laser streaks; 5.45-5.55 a red starburst with black needle spikes inside and a white arc sweep; 5.9-6.3 pink-white slash streak, orange sparks, another flower star

phases.name: aftermath
phases.what: 6.5-6.7: calm void, petals falling

layers.motion: desaturate the caster first (0.4 s), then the whole world after the wipe; keep only red
layers.notes: the colour drain is the 'ultimate starts' signal

layers.motion: petal meshes orbit the caster, then 20-30 giant petals fly at the camera and cover it for 0.4 s
layers.notes: a wipe made from the theme particle

layers.motion: 3/4 circle arc 6 m tall standing behind the target, static for the whole move, mirrored in the floor
layers.notes: one calm clean shape behind all the busy hits

layers.motion: very thin laser streaks crossing the whole screen in 2-3 frames at different heights, fade over 0.15 s
layers.notes: slashes drawn as lasers

layers.motion: six thin pointed petals (flower-star) 1 m, 3 frames per hit
layers.notes: the theme shape used as a hit spark

layers.motion: jagged red starburst 2 m with black needle spikes inside, 3 frames

layers.motion: small orange sparks on the last hit, life 0.3 s
light shakes per hit

whyItLooksGood: Draining the colour first (character, then world) makes red the only hue, so every red element reads instantly
The transition into the void uses the theme's own petals as a wipe instead of a white flash
A static white crescent moon behind the target gives the busy hits a calm frame and is doubled by the wet floor
Hit sparks are flower shapes and red stars with black spikes inside, not generic bursts
buildNotes: Video 0:00.5-0:06.7. ScreenFx: a saturation uniform tweened to 0 for the world (keep the effect layers outside the grade) and a black void/star backdrop for the impact stage (see §10 'charge in a void'). Petals: Emitter with a petal mesh (NEW small mesh), normal blend, then a camera-attached burst of large petals for the wipe. Moon arc: a torus segment or ring quad with soft glow, placed behind the target relative to the camera; a reflective floor is optional (a flipped copy at 30 % opacity). Slashes: 1-px beam-ribbons spanning 20 m, 2-3 frames each. Hit sparks: StarBurst with 6 petal-shaped spikes; a second StarBurst variant with black spikes drawn under the red.

name: Crack-web finisher: a full-screen web of glowing red cracks appears in one frame and holds still, then light rays, two speed-line impact frames and the screen shatters into a pink whiteout

source.title: Divergent Vfx – Acheron Ultimate | Roblox VFX

phases.name: anticipation
phases.what: video 0:06.9-0:10.4. Slow close-up of the caster's face and raised blade, red petals floating (6.9-7.35), then one full-screen pink-red card with a thin horizontal cut line (7.45)

phases.name: release
phases.what: 7.55: a web of glowing red polygon crack lines covers the screen and the floor around the target in one frame; 7.62-8.9 it holds completely still for 1.35 s over the grey world and the white moon arc

phases.name: impact
phases.what: 9.05 white light rays burst from the crack centre, 9.25 full-screen radial speed lines red on black, 9.45 the same white on black, 9.65 the screen breaks into red/black glass shards falling away

phases.name: aftermath
phases.what: 9.9 pink-red wash, 10.2 cream-white whiteout (end)

layers.motion: 1 flat pink-red card with a 1-px white horizontal line, 2 frames
layers.notes: the cut happens off-screen; the card stands for it

layers.motion: full-screen crack-web overlay (20-30 polygon cells radiating from the target's screen position), appears at full size in 1 frame, holds still 1.35 s
layers.notes: the stillness after a sudden crack is the anticipation

layers.motion: matching red crack lines on the floor around the target, same timing
layers.notes: ties the screen crack to the world

layers.motion: fan of 8-10 white rays from the crack centre, 3 frames
2 frames radial speed lines red on black, 2 frames white on black
layers.notes: impact frames as focus lines

layers.motion: the screen image split into ~20 triangles that fall and rotate away over 0.25 s
layers.notes: a screen-space shatter, revealing the wash behind

layers.motion: pink-red wash 0.25 s, then a cream-white hold
layers.notes: exit through a warm white

layers.motion: no shake during the hold; one heavy shake on the shatter

whyItLooksGood: The crack web appears all at once and then nothing moves for 1.35 s: the frozen frame builds more tension than any charge-up
Screen-space cracks plus matching floor cracks make it feel like reality itself broke
The payoff escalates in three different graphic forms in 0.6 s (rays, two speed-line cards, shatter)
Ending in a cream whiteout instead of pure white keeps the red theme warm to the end
buildNotes: Video 0:06.9-0:10.4. NEW ScreenFx passes: (1) crack-web overlay: generate Voronoi edges around the target's screen position (or a hand-made polyline texture), draw thick red lines with a white core, additive; (2) shatter: copy the frame into a texture and split it into ~20 triangles that fall with gravity and spin. Sequence: 2-frame pink card, crack (hold 1.35 s, no shake), 3-frame ray fan (LightPillar quads in screen space), 2+2 frames focus-line cards (existing ScreenFx focus lines in red/black, then white/black), shatter 0.25 s, pink wash, cream hold. Heavy shake only with the shatter.
